notes.note: Section navigation now admits every Project settings section, so a link to a preview section (Brief, Memory, Models and effort, Usage) survives a reload before the preview flags load; the list and panels still show them only with the project-coordination preview. settings.md already says section links remain bookmarkable, which this makes true for the preview sections; settings-architecture.md and shell-skeletons.md describe SectionNavigation and the page header, which are unchanged.
